reviews.t: Best deodorant out there, better than commercial brands, better than antiperspirants
reviews.x: This is my favorite deodorant. I was using Tom's of Maine for a long time but I've been alerted that some ingredients there aren't the best for you. This one is totally non-toxic and it is actually way more effective. I was shocked at how effective it works, even better than antiperspirants that I used to use many years ago. Try it. You won't be disappointed.

I actually love this product. All natural and leaves my pits smell free. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is that it leaves white residue even when dried which means I will not be able to wear sleeveless. Overall, I would recommend this product.

This works extremely well for me, although my wife says it doesn't work for her.  I follow a relatively low protein diet and thus am often low on iron, but those two factors tend to reduce my under-arm odor.  Anyway, a shower in the morning followed by a generous application of this deodorant gives me confidence for the sweatiest of tasks.  I'm about to place my 3rd order.

This is the only natural deodorant I have ever used that worked well. It prevents odor and is not irritating. I like the fact that unlike the aluminum in other deodorants, the magnesium in this one is a mineral actually used by the body so that I feel comfortable about it being absorbed through the skin.
First of all, I thought I was getting two, but only received one. And unfortunately, I get stinky pit smell immediately with this, worse than with nothing!  SO disappointed!

reviews.x: I have reviewed this before and continue to use this great deodorant! I had an underarm rash that just wouldn't go away, but after using this for a couple of weeks, the rash was gone and has never come back! I see some have complained that it is wet and leaves a white film on clothes (it does wash off), but if you have the time, use a hair dryer and dry your underarm, hey it works!

Love this deoderant! After trying multiple 'natural' products that all led to angry rashes & itching, this is a breath of fresh air. I have hot flashes & this doesn't stop me from sweating but it does help with the odor. If it is super hot out I may have to reapply midday, but my armpits are happy & rash-free!

reviews.t: I've never found the perfect deodorant until "now"
reviews.x: I've never found the perfect deodorant until "now"! I've changed brands so many times over the several years, never finding one that worked good and didn't leave behind a sticky like residue on my skin. This works really, really good and give me peace of mind being aluminum free.

reviews.t: MoM (Milk of Magnesia ) is the most effective deodorant I've ever used....
reviews.x: My review is just generally for Milk of Magnesia as a deodorant and I imagine using a roll-on would be practical. I think it's a bit expensive here, but again, surely practical.
Does take awhile to dry but it works and it is the only natural like deodorant that I I found that works.
Love it. It's the only deodorant I have found that works and stays dry all day.

If you use other deodorants and you still experience an odor TRY THIS! My first purchase was about a year ago...I originally bought and refilled with the "scent free". This time I accidentally bought this one but...they BOTH work equally well.  Forget about odor and use Mom's!  If it sounds like a commercial...I am just a happy consumer...it truly is the BEST!

As Man, the search for the perfect deodorant never ends. We were designed imperfect beings, the sin made flesh, the piece made whole. Eden is gone. Heaven is beyond. But Aluminum Free Mom (Milk of Magnesia) Deodorant is the bridge we can walk that spans the two.  Plus, one lick of your pits and you're flushed out like an empty PVC pipe.

I continuously recommended this product to any one who has problems with body odor. I had tried everything, but this product, it really works. I have purchased for family members that are having problems with underarm odor. Now this is the only underarm product.

I love this deodorant.  I keep ordering it EVERYTIME.  I've tried so many deodorants, and this is the only one that works.  I think it has to do with the magnesia in it.  I wish it was sold in stores so I don't have to keep paying for shipping.

reviews.x: I had to reapply twice during the day after the first application in the morning. I felt like I was just a teeny bit funky by the end of the day. Now I only use it during the winter months.

reviews.t: Works perfectly and lasts all day. I work hard ...
reviews.x: Works perfectly and lasts all day. I work hard and get sweaty in the heat of summer even inside in AC and this never lets me down. I have bought my second already as I apply it liberally.
This is probably the best natural deodorant I've used. No aluminum, not even natural alum. No fragrances.  No B.O. The only downside is that it's a roll on and takes a while to dry.
I've been looking for a natural deodorant for a while and stumbled upon this. Great product that really works. I've had no skin irritation to it and it's got no smell.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it highly effective at preventing odor, often better than commercial or antiperspirant products.
Several reviewers say it is gentle and non-irritating, even helping with rashes, unlike other deodorants.
Some reviewers complain it leaves a white residue or film on skin and clothes.
A few reviewers find it overpriced for the small amount, especially compared to generic Milk of Magnesia.
A minority report it did not work for them or stopped working, with some still getting odor.
